jobs.title: Autumn ember
jobs.direction: A compact round, friendly hedgehog creature with large warm amber eyes, a short rounded muzzle, small ears, layered copper-orange maple leaves and short reddish wooden thorn quills. Low broad stance. Clearly autumn, cheerful face, no glowing fire.

jobs.title: Moss garden
jobs.direction: A stocky, gentle hedgehog creature with a rounded tan face, big deep brown eyes, softer rounded green fern fronds, moss cushion between short woody quills, a few tiny white woodland flowers. Green spring palette. Strong readable rounded silhouette and four sturdy connected paws.

jobs.title: Moon bramble
jobs.direction: A sleek, alert hedgehog creature with a narrower tapered silver-beige muzzle, bright teal eyes, dark blue-green pointed holly leaves and elegant curved silver-grey thorn quills. Longer silhouette and slightly taller legs, small upright ears. Subtle blue-green moonlit palette, still painted forest animal, no armor or clothing.

jobs.title: Briar guardian
jobs.direction: A broad strong hedgehog creature with a wide expressive russet face, golden eyes, heavy curved dark wooden thorns and overlapping deep green oak leaves. Deep chest and thick sturdy legs; one small berry cluster among leaves. Proud protective expression; slightly taller and heavier than reference, friendly enough for a children’s game.
